_contract.units: metres; provisional asset-local coordinates (director-approved 2026-11-18); NOT a WORLD placement
_contract.axes: glTF Y-up (exported from Blender Z-up); pivot = root at ground contact (y=0); +X east in asset space
_contract.wind: per-vertex _WIND_WEIGHT (0 root .. 1 tip) x node extras eco_wind {amplitude_m, frequency_hz, flutter}; global input = scene wind channel lind_wind_strength 0..1 (0 = wind-stop event: all sway must reach 0)
_contract.colour: baseColor = baseColorTexture x COLOR_0 (glTF spec); vertex-colour-only meshes have no baseColorTexture
_contract.alpha: leaf/needle cards + impostors: alphaMode MASK cutoff 0.5, doubleSided
_contract.game_camera: fixed 28 deg quarter-view orthographic, 1.75 m figure ~45-48 px on 720 p
_contract.lod_policy_game_camera: the game camera is fixed-distance orthographic, so LOD is chosen per role, not by distance: LOD1 = in-game default; LOD0 = cutscene/close camera only; LOD2 = background rows, distant hills, or Android low tier
_contract.density_unit: instances per 100 m2 of eligible surface, LOD1

turf_carpet.notes: tile centres on a 1.3 m jittered grid (~30 % overlap) so feathered edges interleave; leave worn bands bare along routes. LOD2 flat decal is a self-FAIL (see QA) — do not use as the in-game carpet.

grass_accent.notes: on top of turf, clustered near rocks/fences/building feet

grass_cliff_edge.yaw: align lean to prevailing_wind_xy +- 15 deg (asset is pre-combed)
grass_cliff_edge.notes: only within 3 m of the cliff lip; never the carpet

flower_meadow.notes: scale up to 1.4 is allowed: approved CGs exaggerate daisy heads for readability

flower_village.notes: not on the exposed cliff top

moss_mat.rule: only where surface normal.y > 0.6 (upward-facing); prefer north/shaded side
moss_mat.shader_alternative: for rocks owned by PR #421 do NOT add geometry; blend textures/moss_tile_* in the rock shader with mask = smoothstep(0.55, 0.8, normal.y) x cavity, tile 0.5 m

shrub_low.notes: on the cliff top only in the lee of rocks/hollows (wind-exposed lip stays open)

hedgerow.placement: along boundary splines, 4.0 m step, yaw = spline tangent, scale [0.9, 1.1]

tree_broadleaf.notes: single framing trees; none within 15 m of the cliff lip

tree_orchard.placement: rows 5 m apart, 4.5 m in-row, jitter 0.4 m

riverbank.notes: reeds only on the slow inner bank, never over the water surface
